milestones.name: Three looks for the appointment page, for the owner to choose from
milestones.bar: Each option is readable and tappable at 375 px and different in kind from the others, not in colour alone

items.statement: Three options, different in kind, for the screen that shows the appointment and offers new times, each with the same sample appointment at 375 px wide
items.inspect: each option at 375 px, and enlarged, in docs/evidence/APPOINTMENT_PAGE/options.png, laid side by side as one image
items.evidence: docs/evidence/APPOINTMENT_PAGE/options.png (sheet: 375 px and 2x), options.md (inspection), options/*.png at 375 px via options/capture.mjs

items.statement: The owner has chosen one option, or a mix of them
items.ask: Has the owner's choice of option been recorded with owner answer, and which option, or mix, is it?
items.attended: the owner looks at the options sheet and says which one to build; the lead records it with owner answer

milestones.blocked: attended items need a person or hardware: M1.2. M1.2 needs the owner. They look at `docs/evidence/APPOINTMENT_PAGE/options.png` and choose A, B, C or a mix, and the lead records it with `owner answer`. After that, M1.2 can be marked passed and M1 claimed for review.

milestones.name: A customer moves their appointment from the email link on a phone
milestones.bar: In the owner's chosen look, as plain and quick on a phone as moving a booking from a Fresha or Treatwell confirmation email, one decision per screen

items.statement: Through the page alone, with no JavaScript, a customer with a private link sees their appointment, chooses a free time with the same stylist, confirms, and sees the new time; choosing another stylist works the same way
items.target: proxy:web-mobile, over HTTP from node:test with no browser

items.statement: Inside the cut-off, the page shows the appointment and the salon's phone number and offers no move; an unknown link shows no appointment details; a time taken while choosing changes nothing and shows fresh times
items.target: proxy:web-mobile, over HTTP from node:test with no browser

items.statement: Opening any page never changes anything, and the pages behind the link send no-store, no-referrer and noindex
items.target: proxy:web-mobile, over HTTP from node:test with no browser

items.statement: The page uses only the BOOKINGS interface, and its tests drive the real thing
items.ask: Does the page read or change appointments only through findByLink, freeTimesByLink and moveByLink, and do the M2 tests run against the real BOOKINGS store rather than a stand-in?
items.target: proxy:web-mobile, over HTTP from node:test with no browser

items.statement: Every state reads clearly and is easy to tap at phone size, in the chosen look
items.inspect: started with npm run demo from a clean clone, at 375 x 812: the appointment, choosing a time, choosing another stylist, confirming, moved, time just taken, no free times, inside the cut-off, cancelled, unknown link; compared with the chosen option

items.statement: The same stylist is what a customer gets unless they deliberately pick another
items.inspect: the choose-a-time screen and the confirm screen at 375 px: whether the current stylist is the default, and whether changing stylist needs a deliberate step and is shown on the confirm screen

items.statement: The owner finds it easy enough that customers would use it instead of phoning
items.ask: Has the owner said, in an answer recorded with owner answer, that the page is easy enough for customers to use instead of phoning?
items.attended: the owner opens a demo link on their own phone, moves the appointment, and says whether it is easy enough
